rules.cwe_name: Assignment to Variable without Use
rules.description: If an object literal has two properties with the same name, the second property overwrites the first one, which makes the code hard to understand and error-prone.

rules.cwe_name: Loop with Unreachable Exit Condition ('Infinite Loop')
rules.description: A 'for' loop that increments its loop variable but checks it against a lower bound, or decrements its loop variable but checks it against an upper bound, will either stop iterating immediately or keep iterating indefinitely, and is usually indicative of a typo.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
rules.description: Functions recursively assigning properties on objects may be the cause of accidental modification of a built-in prototype object.

rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.

rules.cwe_name: Excessive Iteration
rules.description: Iterating over an object with a user-controlled .length property can cause indefinite looping.

rules.cwe_name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
rules.description: Processing user-controlled object hierarchies inefficiently can lead to denial of service.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Handling of Case Sensitivity
rules.description: Middleware with case-sensitive paths do not protect endpoints with case-insensitive paths.

rules.cwe_name: Reliance on Undefined, Unspecified, or Implementation-Defined Behavior
rules.description: If an HTML element has two attributes with the same name but different values, its behavior may be browser-dependent.

rules.cwe_name: Relative Path Traversal
rules.description: Accessing paths influenced by users can allow an attacker to access unexpected resources.

rules.cwe_name: Access of Resource Using Incompatible Type ('Type Confusion')
rules.description: Sanitizing an HTTP request parameter may be ineffective if the user controls its type.

rules.cwe_name: Use of Potentially Dangerous Function
rules.description: The 'eval' function and the 'Function' constructor execute strings as code. This is dangerous and impedes program analysis and understanding. Consequently, these two functions should not be used.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions
rules.description: Calling a method with a user-controlled name may dispatch to an unexpected target, which could cause an exception.

rules.cwe_name: Dead Code
rules.description: If two conditions in an 'if'-'else if' chain are identical, the second condition will never hold.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Input Validation
rules.description: Data provided remotely is used in this external API without sanitization, which could be a security risk.

rules.cwe_name: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
rules.description: Instantiating a template using a user-controlled object is vulnerable to local file read and potential remote code execution.
